name: Survivors of Strigos
source: Sylvania Supplement, Grade 2a warband, converted from mordheimer.net (/docs/warbands/grade-2a-warbands/survivors-of-strigos) on 2026-10-10.

heroSlots.notes: A feral vampire of the fallen Strigoi bloodline and the warband's only Undead model. Each warband must have exactly one; if he dies the warband does not disband, but a new one may never be hired.

specialRules.name: No Pain
specialRules.description: Treats a Stunned result on the Injury chart as Knocked Down.

specialRules.name: Tooth and Claw
specialRules.description: May not wield any weapons or use equipment from the lists; suffers no penalties for fighting unarmed.

specialRules.name: Dark Arts
specialRules.description: If he learns the Dark Arts special skill he becomes a caster and rolls spells from the Dark Arts list (see spells.txt).

heroSlots.notes: A Strigany fortune-teller and hedge-witch. 0-1 per warband.

specialRules.note: Starts with one random spell from the Strigany Charms & Hexes list (a variant of the standard list, see spells.txt).

specialRules.name: Seeker
specialRules.description: If she took part in the battle and was not taken Out of Action, she may modify one exploration die by +1 or -1.

heroSlots.notes: Strigany men of the clans who still serve the last of the Strigoi. 0-3 per warband.

specialRules.name: Child of Darkness
specialRules.description: Immune to the Spooky special rule for Sylvania.

specialRules.name: Gypsy Ward
specialRules.description: A special save of 5+ against magical attacks.

henchmenTypes.notes: Strigany clansfolk who follow the Strigoi. 0-5 per warband.
Twisted, repulsive cannibals. They never carry any equipment apart from a few bones used as primitive weapons (no equipment list).
Huge bats that fight with jaws and brutality and use no equipment. 0-2 per warband.

specialRules.name: Flying
specialRules.description: Does not need to climb or leap over gaps, even if its movement ends over open air.

specialRules.name: Sonic
specialRules.description: Navigates by sonic vibrations; no Line of Sight is needed to declare a charge.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Chest Talon
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Close combat, Strength as user +1. Two-handed: may not use a shield, buckler or additional weapon in close combat (a shield still gives +1 armour save against shooting). Heart-pierce: +1 to wound against a blood-thirster (vampire).

exclusiveEquipment.name: Black Gold Wristbands
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Heroes only. 35 gc in the warband list; 35 + 2D6 gc when bought later (Rare 10).
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Quickened: the wearer gets a 6+ save against all missile fire, including magical missiles. Stacks with Dodge.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Ring of Strigos
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Heroes only. 20 gc in the warband list; 20 + D6 gc when bought later (Rare 9).
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Arcane Barrier: the wearer gets a 6+ save against spells that target or affect him.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Cursed Book
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Heroes only. 50 gc in the warband list; 50 + 3D6 gc when bought later (Rare 11).
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Cursed Aura: enemy models within 2" of the bearer suffer -1 to hit in close combat.

specialRules: Undead Leader: The Strigoi Vampire is the only Undead model in the warband. The warband does not disband if the Strigoi is killed, but it may never hire a new one. | Hired Swords: The warband may hire any Hired Sword available to Undead warbands. | Heroes Only Items: Black Gold Wristbands, the Ring of Strigos, Unholy Relics and Cursed Books may only be bought by Heroes. | Chest Talon: Only Strigany (not the Strigoi Vampire, Ghouls or Giant Bats) may use the Chest Talon. | Strigoi Weapons: The Strigoi Vampire may never wield weapons and fights with tooth and claw, without penalties for fighting unarmed.
